summary: Honest dry-stop (era-4 structure-and-tape complete, J-01..J-07 passing): no hold-out survivor and no state/pnl-scan.json exists. The sole era-4 data-pattern candidate structure_tape was already screened a non-survivor by J-06's live sweep (hold-out n=1 < promotion_min_sample_size=5); champion still v1/default; PnL ledger still 1 founding row. The only keyless dataset source is the single committed PG_SIP_REFERENCE window (train 60s / holdout 45s -> n=1 per split); reaching n>=5 needs SOURCE_HISTORICAL (Alpaca credentials) = a credentialed operator action, not a build-cycle output. Recorded 3 candidates, all non-survivors: 1 dataset (structurally keyless-infeasible, same rejection as prior era, no new evidence) and 2 speculative surface ideas (levels UI explicitly out-of-scope per goal.md; overfit-label refinement audit-classified non-gating) both below the usefulness lens. Per guidance sections 4 and 8 no promotion or tuning journey is proposable with the scan absent/insufficient-n, so goal.md AUTO:journeys left byte-untouched. Resume when the operator registers real-scale SOURCE_HISTORICAL hold-out datasets (n>=5) or the champion changes.
